$comment: Which work runs in a Claude Code on the web session instead of on this machine. Read by the remote-work skill's guard hook and by remote-work.sh prepare (dravr-savoir platform/skills/remote-work/policy.sh). An entry names a command by 'match' (words at a command position) or 'pattern' (an extended regex matched anywhere). Overrides for one developer go in .claude/remote-work.local.json (git-ignored), deep-merged over this file; a list there replaces the list here.

pressure.$comment: A permitted entry with remote_when_busy goes remote while either threshold is crossed: 1-minute load per core, or swap in use in GB. macOS grows swap on demand, so a swap percentage reads near 100% whenever anything is swapped; GB is the meaningful unit.

forced.why: strict clippy is heavy; the cloud runs it exactly as CI does

prohibited.why: needs the local stack: port 8081, the dev database, .envrc
starts or resets the local dev stack
dev servers, tunnels and e2e need the local stack, a browser or a simulator
needs a simulator, a device or a browser
outward-facing: a remote runner never publishes
touches secrets, which would travel into a cloud session

sessions.$comment: What a cloud session is for, in this project. remote_role is enforced by remote-work.sh: "verify" makes prepare refuse --commit; "commit" lets a run commit to refs/remote-work/<id> only.
rules: A cloud session builds and tests the patch prepare sends and answers a VERDICT. It commits only when prepare --commit asks, and only to refs/remote-work/<id>: never a branch, never main, no CI.
remote-work.sh land recreates that commit on a local feature branch, signed and through the local hooks; pushes go from this machine and CI on the pushed SHA is the final word.
Every routine carries clear_mcp_connections: true. A cloud session never releases, deploys or writes the tracker.

remote.$comment: How a run is built (remote-work.sh prepare). sources are attached to the cloud session; the proxy authenticates only attached repos, and every dravr-ai git dependency in Cargo.lock is private, so cargo_git_owner attaches those too.
bootstrap: git submodule update --init --recursive && bash .build/ci/savoir.sh sync && head -1 .savoir/platform/AGENTS.md
remote.fallback: push a feature/* or claude/* branch and read CI (scripts/ci/ci-verdict.sh <sha>)
